reasons: Cited clause 8.2 matches the preferred position on every material term: 12-month (not multi-year) renewal terms, a 30-day Customer non-renewal notice window, and a Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal, plus an opt-out extension if the reminder is missed (more favourable to us than preferred).
Clause 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods, satisfying the preferred price-cap element.
Deterministic check confirms the notice window at 30 days, well within the ≤30-day preferred threshold and far from the >90-day walk-away zone.
Consistent with a compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed; the unchanged paragraphs are appropriate and the rationale accurately reflects the cited text.

Only immaterial quirk noted (defined term 'Fees' is the Implementation Fee while 8.3 speaks of 'recurring Fees'), which is a drafting artifact outside this rule's material terms and correctly not flagged.
